parsed.explanation: Severe-risk profile dominated by state-tolerated, organised targeting: police run dating-app entrapment campaigns in which transgender women are specifically targeted, with blackmail, arrests, documented custody abuse and coerced anal examinations; prosecutions proceed through morality/sex-work provisions carrying prison terms despite no explicit trans offence. Immigration law is directly visitor-facing: foreign nationals suspected of being gay or trans deported without any upheld charge (incidents to 2022). No anti-discrimination recourse, legal gender recognition actively closed, hostile media incitement with state complicity (2017 raid collaboration; jailed broadcaster), pervasive healthcare discrimination. The absence of dated arrests after 2017 is flagged as a documentation gap, not safety. Recourse is absent; authorities turn a blind eye. This sits between organised-state targeting (0.15 tier) and high-risk raids, closest to severe risk given frequency, visitor-relevant deportation power and failed remedies.
